channel.title: European Open Source
channel.description: Discover open source projects from Europe

item.title: Qisutu
item.description: Qisutu is a European free and open-source ticketing, helpdesk and service desk platform with customer and agent portals, workflow automation, SLA management, reporting, a knowledge base and an integrated CMDB. It supports eleven languages and can be operated on an organizations own infrastructure or professionally hosted. Qisutu is designed for data sovereignty, extensibility and professional support operations.

item.title: Mango
item.description: Mango is an AI agent that turns natural language questions into MongoDB queries (NL to MQL) through an LLM-based orchestration system. It combines a FastAPI backend with real-time streaming, a three-layer vector-store memory for few-shot learning, and support for multiple LLM providers including local models via Ollama. It is read-only by design, rejecting write operations at the tool level for safe production use.

item.title: Proxmox VE
item.description: Proxmox VE is an open-source server virtualization platform combining KVM hypervisor and LXC containers with a unified web-based management interface. Built by Proxmox Server Solutions GmbH in Vienna, it enables management of VMs, containers, storage, and networking across bare-metal clusters without vendor lock-in.

item.title: OpenSparrow
item.description: OpenSparrow is an open-source, self-hosted platform designed to create internal systems, CRUD applications, admin dashboards, and calendars in minutes. Driven by a philosophy of absolute simplicity, the platform is schema-driven (generating forms and tables from configuration files) and features zero external dependencies. It is written entirely in native PHP and vanilla JavaScript, backed by a PostgreSQL database, making it extremely lightweight, fast, and secure.

item.title: Krita
item.description: Krita is a professional free and open-source digital painting application developed by the Krita Foundation in the Netherlands. Designed for illustrators, concept artists, and matte painters, it offers advanced brush engines, layer management, HDR support, and animation tools in a focused interface.

item.title: OPNsense
item.description: OPNsense is an open-source, FreeBSD-based firewall and routing platform developed by Deciso B.V. in Middelburg, Netherlands. Forked from pfSense, it offers a modern web UI, weekly security updates, stateful packet inspection, intrusion detection, VPN, and traffic shaping for enterprise network security.

item.title: Godot Engine
item.description: Godot Engine is a free, open-source, cross-platform game engine developed under the Stichting Godot (Dutch non-profit). It supports 2D and 3D game development with its own GDScript language, visual scripting, and C bindings providing a complete, MIT-licensed alternative to proprietary game engines.

item.title: Blender
item.description: Blender is a free and open-source 3D creation suite maintained by the Blender Foundation in Amsterdam. It supports the full 3D pipeline modeling, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, compositing, and motion tracking and is the leading open-source tool for film, games, and design production.

item.title: NixOS
item.description: NixOS is a declarative, reproducible Linux distribution built on the Nix package manager, stewarded by the NixOS Foundation in the Netherlands. Its entire system configuration is expressed in Nix, enabling atomic upgrades, rollbacks, and reproducible environments a foundational tool for infrastructure-as-code.

item.title: Baserow
item.description: Baserow is an open-source no-code database and spreadsheet platform built by Baserow B.V. in Amsterdam. It provides a collaborative, Airtable-like interface for structured data with a REST API, self-hosting capability, and a plugin system for custom fields, views, and application logic.

item.title: kube-green
item.description: kube-green is a Kubernetes operator that automatically suspends and restarts workloads outside business hours to reduce energy consumption and cloud costs. Created by Italian maintainers and listed in the CNCF landscape, it embeds sustainability directly into Kubernetes cluster management.

item.title: Rasa
item.description: Rasa is an open-source framework for building production-grade conversational AI assistants, developed by Rasa Technologies GmbH in Berlin. It provides NLU, dialogue management, and integration tools to deploy custom chatbots and voice assistants without relying on proprietary cloud AI services.

item.title: OpenNebula
item.description: OpenNebula is an open-source cloud computing platform for managing heterogeneous distributed data center infrastructures, developed by OpenNebula Systems in Madrid. It supports KVM, LXC, and VMware hypervisors and provides a vendor-neutral cloud management stack used by enterprises and research institutions across Europe.

item.title: Qdrant
item.description: Qdrant is a high-performance, open-source vector similarity search engine and database built in Rust by Qdrant Solutions GmbH in Berlin. It enables fast nearest-neighbor search over dense and sparse vectors with filtering, making it core infrastructure for AI, recommendation systems, and semantic search.

item.title: ownCloud Infinite Scale
item.description: ownCloud Infinite Scale (oCIS) is the modern, cloud-native rewrite of ownCloud built by ownCloud GmbH in Nuremberg. Written in Go with a microservices architecture, it provides enterprise-grade file sync, sharing, and collaboration with horizontal scalability and full data sovereignty.

item.title: Haystack
item.description: Haystack is an open-source LLM orchestration framework for building production-ready AI applications such as RAG pipelines, semantic search, and question answering systems. Developed by deepset GmbH in Berlin, it provides a modular pipeline-based architecture supporting all major LLM providers.

item.title: Nextcloud
item.description: Nextcloud is an open-source self-hosted productivity platform for file sync, sharing, and collaboration. Built by Nextcloud GmbH in Stuttgart, it combines cloud storage with integrated apps for calendar, contacts, mail, video calls, and office documents a privacy-first alternative to proprietary cloud services.

item.title: scikit-learn
item.description: scikit-learn is the leading Python library for machine learning, offering a consistent API for classification, regression, clustering, and dimensionality reduction. Originally developed at INRIA, the French national research institute, it is the foundational ML toolkit for the Python data science ecosystem.

item.title: OpenCTI
item.description: OpenCTI is an open-source Cyber Threat Intelligence platform developed by Filigran in France. It structures threat data using STIX 2 standards with MITRE ATT&CK integration, enabling security teams to manage and share intelligence on adversaries, campaigns, and indicators of compromise.

item.title: Dolibarr
item.description: Dolibarr is a modular open-source ERP and CRM platform for small businesses, associations, and freelancers, born in France. It covers invoicing, contacts, orders, inventory, HR, and accounting in a single self-hostable application with an active third-party module marketplace.

item.title: VLC
item.description: VLC is a free, open-source, cross-platform multimedia player maintained by VideoLAN, a French non-profit. It plays virtually any audio or video format without additional codecs, runs on all major platforms, and is widely regarded as the world's most used media player.

item.title: API Platform
item.description: API Platform is a full-stack framework built on Symfony for rapidly creating REST and GraphQL APIs with automatic OpenAPI documentation and schema generation. Created by Les-Tilleuls.coop in France, it supports JSON-LD, Hydra, and JSON:API standards.

item.title: Strapi
item.description: Strapi is the leading open-source headless CMS built by Strapi SAS in Paris. Its community edition (MIT) provides a customizable content API with a self-hosted admin panel supporting REST and GraphQL, enabling developers to structure and deliver content to any frontend without vendor lock-in.

item.title: Mobilizon
item.description: Mobilizon is a free, federated event and group management platform built by Framasoft in France. Based on ActivityPub, it enables organizations and communities to publish events and coordinate members without surveillance-driven social networks, connecting across the Fediverse.

item.title: PeerTube
item.description: PeerTube is a free, federated, and decentralized video hosting platform developed by Framasoft in Lyon. Built on ActivityPub and WebTorrent, it allows anyone to host their own video server that interconnects across the Fediverse, providing a privacy-respecting alternative to centralized platforms.

item.title: Funkwhale
item.description: Funkwhale is a federated, open-source audio streaming and sharing platform originating from France. Built with Django and ActivityPub, it lets communities host music, podcast, and audio libraries that interconnect across the Fediverse, prioritizing user ownership over centralized streaming.

item.title: X-Road
item.description: X-Road is an open-source data exchange layer enabling secure, standardized digital communication between organizations and government systems. Developed by NIIS a joint body of Estonia and Finland it underpins national e-governance infrastructure and is adopted by governments worldwide.

item.title: Plausible
item.description: Plausible is a lightweight, privacy-first, GDPR-compliant web analytics platform built by Plausible Insights OÜ in Estonia. With no cookies and no personal data collection, it delivers actionable traffic insights through a clean dashboard while remaining fully open-source and self-hostable.

item.title: SECA
item.description: SECA (Sovereign European Cloud API) is an open industry standard for cloud infrastructure management, developed as a building block for the EuroStack. Backed by European cloud providers including Aruba (Italy) and IONOS (Germany), the specification follows the OpenAPI Initiative's conventions to ensure broad developer trust and easy inspection.

item.title: Euro-OS
item.description: Euro-OS is a desktop operating system built from scratch in Rust, with an integrated office suite, sovereign AI agents, support for 24 European languages, and full-disk encryption enabled by default. It ships with zero telemetry and fully open code, positioned as an everyday desktop rather than a specialized security distribution.

item.title: Xinity Runtime
item.description: Xinity Runtime is a self-hosted, open-source AI platform for on-premise LLM inference. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible API with multi-model orchestration and a management dashboard, letting regulated organizations run generative AI on their own hardware with zero data egress.

item.title: Vship
item.description: Vship is a GPU-accelerated library for computing perceptual video quality metrics, SSIMULACRA2, Butteraugli, and CVVDP, significantly faster than CPU-based tools. It supports Vulkan, CUDA, and HIP, and ships with FFVship, a CLI for encoder developers who want faster, more accurate quality tuning than PSNR, SSIM, or VMAF provide.

item.title: Writher
item.description: Writher is an offline voice assistant and dictation tool for Windows, built in Python. It lets you dictate text into any application and manage notes, appointments, and reminders hands-free, without sending audio to any cloud service.

item.title: FlowDrop
item.description: FlowDrop is a visual workflow editor component built with Svelte 5 and xyflow/svelte for embedding drag-and-drop flow builders into your own applications. You control the backend and infrastructure end to end: workflows run on your own servers with your own data and security rules, with no vendor lock-in or data leaving your systems.

item.title: Raspberry Pi OS
item.description: Raspberry Pi OS is the official Linux-based operating system for Raspberry Pi single-board computers, maintained by the Raspberry Pi Foundation in Cambridge, UK. Based on Debian, it provides a beginner-friendly desktop and CLI environment, built and distributed through pi-gen, the open-source image build system.

item.title: Qubes OS
item.description: Qubes OS is a security-focused desktop operating system based on Xen hypervisor isolation, developed by Invisible Things Lab in Warsaw. It compartmentalizes user activities into separate virtual machines to contain security breaches, offering hardware-enforced isolation as the primary security mechanism.

item.title: Forgejo
item.description: Forgejo is a self-hosted, lightweight Git forge focused on community ownership and ethical software practices. Maintained by Codeberg e.V. in Berlin, it provides a full GitHub alternative with repositories, issues, pull requests, and CI/CD runnable on minimal hardware.

item.title: Fenn
item.description: Friendly Environment for Neural Networks (fenn) is an open-source framework that streamlines machine learning and deep learning workflows. It offers ready-to-use trainers, YAML-based configuration, automated logging, experiment tracking, real-time notifications, and reusable project templates. With fenn, researchers and developers can focus on models and data while the framework manages training, validation, testing, reproducibility, and repetitive infrastructure needed to run solid experiments efficiently.

item.title: Longevity World Cup
item.description: Open-source longevity sport platform from Hungary with biological-age calculators, athlete profiles, public leaderboards, and machine-readable longevity data/API endpoints for healthspan tracking and comparison.

item.title: CryptPad
item.description: CryptPad is an open-source, end-to-end encrypted collaborative office suite built in JavaScript. It offers real-time editing of documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and more with zero-knowledge encryption ensuring that neither the server nor any third party can access the content.

item.title: Freelens
item.description: Freelens is a free and open-source graphical IDE for Kubernetes cluster management, forked from OpenLens to preserve a fully community-driven development. It delivers an intuitive cross-platform interface (macOS, Windows, Linux) with a rich extension ecosystem. Actively maintained by a European core team with a vendor-neutral, transparency-first philosophy aligned with cloud-native standards.

item.title: XWiki
item.description: XWiki is a second-generation open-source wiki platform built in Java, enabling organizations to build intranets, knowledge bases, digital workplaces, and custom collaborative solutions. It offers structured data, extensions, scripting, and full data sovereignty with self-hosted or cloud deployment.

item.title: Capsule
item.description: Capsule implements a multi-tenant and policy-based environment in your Kubernetes cluster. It is designed as a micro-services-based ecosystem with the minimalist approach, leveraging only on upstream Kubernetes.

item.title: SquashTM
item.description: SquashTM is an open-core test management solution that centralises all testing activities, from requirements to execution results. It lets teams build a structured, reusable test repository, manage campaigns across manual, automated, and exploratory testing, and maintain full traceability between requirements and test coverage. Agnostic by design, it integrates with GitLab, OpenProject (Q1 2027), Jira, Jenkins and other CI/CD tools, supporting Agile, V-model, and hybrid methodologies. On-premise or cloud.

item.title: Grinning Cat
item.description: Build production-ready AI agents in minutes, not months. Grinning Cat is a multi-tenant microservice for deploying scalable chatbots with advanced RAG capabilities. Manage multiple chatbots with isolated settings, plugins, and LLMs. Process any document type - PDFs, images, audio, and more. Cloud-native and dockerized with single-command deployment.

item.title: Medha
item.description: Medha is an asynchronous, high-performance semantic cache library designed specifically for Text-to-Query systems. Unlike traditional key-value caches that require exact string matches, Medha understands that "Show me the top 5 users" and "List the first five users" are the same question. It intercepts these queries and returns pre-calculated database queries (SQL, Cypher, etc.), bypassing the expensive and slow LLM generation step.

item.title: hetzner-k3s
item.description: hetzner-k3s is a CLI tool that creates production-ready Kubernetes clusters on Hetzner Cloud in minutes, not hours. No Terraform to learn, no management cluster required, no third-party access to your credentials.

item.title: datapizza-ai
item.description: datapizza-ai is a Python GenAI framework for building agents from development to production with minimal abstraction. It supports multi-provider LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral), built-in OpenTelemetry tracing, modular RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration. Built by the Italian Data & AI community Datapizza.

item.title: Distrobox
item.description: Distrobox is a shell tool by Italian developer Luca Di Maio that runs any Linux distribution inside a container in the terminal, with full host integration. Using Podman, Docker, or lilipod, it shares the home directory, display, audio, and USB devices — enabling seamless cross-distro software compatibility on any Linux system.

item.title: Drupal
item.description: Drupal is a free, open-source content management framework written in PHP, used to build websites, portals, and digital experiences at any scale. Founded in Belgium by Dries Buytaert, it powers millions of sites worldwide including government, enterprise, and educational platforms, with a vast ecosystem of modules and themes.
